notes: Soul: drops (soul_index 17, soul_rarity 60), is collected and casts SkillAluraUneUse (held, 60 MP per second, the translucent healer behind Soma). Animations: ported from EnemyAluraUneCreate (0x0807C0A0) / EnemyAluraUneUpdate (0x0807CF9C) and the sub_0807C150 scythe phase, sub_0807C494 blade phase, sub_0807C888 materialize, sub_0807C8FC hurt, sub_0807C9A4 scythe spawn / sub_0807CAD4 scythe update and sub_0807CC9C orbit blade spawn / sub_0807CDA8 blade update; unit-tested in alura_une_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x6A (first hurt), 0x6E (death) and 0x80 (orbit blade) are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Loot: the native record drops rare item 0x0015 (no common item). Divergences: the 0x105 room events, the sub_08011F7C screen pulses, the sub_0806D54C aggro helper and several native helpers are approximated or skipped, the eight-child cap truncates the twelve-blade volley, and there is no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillAxeArmorUse). Sounds: its native sounds are requested and unit-tested: 0x86 when its axe is struck, 0x6F at the start of its death and 0x6E every 8 frames of it, 0xE3 when its soul is cast (SkillAxeArmorUse); a local run rendered each through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 30, rare item 0x0029 through the generic roll) and is collected, but its red soul 15 (routine 0x08025361) has no ported update yet. Animations: EnemyBasiliskCreate (0x080BC1F8) / EnemyBasiliskUpdate (0x080BC204) are aliases of the Cockatrice family — sub_080BBFF0(e, 1) and a byte-identical update sharing sub_080BBCC4 / sub_080BBD90 / sub_080BBEE4 and the sub_080BB924 shadow and sub_080BBAC4 rock children; unit-tested in cockatrice_tests. Sounds: the shared routines' PlaySong 0x65 (rock end, death start) and 0x6E (every eighth death tick) apply, unit-tested through the Cockatrice tests. Divergences: identical to Cockatrice's (no emulator comparison).

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillBatUse). Sounds: its only native sound, 0x72 at the start of its death (sub_080AD5B8), is requested, unit-tested and mixed (a local run rendered it, not listened to).

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillBeamSkeletonUse: a skull beside Soma firing its beam). Sounds: its native sound 0x6B as it shatters (sub_080CB4F0) is requested and unit-tested, its bones land with 0x162 (sub_0806C5AC); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 20 through the generic roll, no common or rare item in the record) and is collected, but its yellow soul 37 (routine 0x08028801) has no ported update yet. Animations: ported from EnemyBiphronCreate (0x08099C5C) / EnemyBiphronUpdate (0x0809A450) and the sub_08099CF0 / sub_08099ED8 / sub_08099DB8 state handlers — animation 0 looping hover, animation 1 attack with the sub_08099FD0 projectile at frame 4, animation 3 death burst, state 3 affine idle; unit-tested in biphron_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x78 at the attack shot, 0x6E in the death burst and 0x77 on the projectile trail are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the sub_08069A00 walker is walk_collide with the Biphron arguments, the sub_08042848 projectile physics preset 0x0E14F2FB is approximated by a forward drift, the sub_0806D644 / sub_0809A340 spark and sprite pieces are approximated by AOS_EFFECT_SPARK, the sub_0809A0DC trail likewise, the + 0x5A palette merges and the blink are not ported, and the awake gate sub_0806CC20 uses the usual activity handling.

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (sub_SkillBlueCrowUse: a crow circling Soma). Sounds: its native sounds are requested and unit-tested: 0x8B as it takes off (sub_080C9AF4) and 0x72 at the start of its death (sub_080C9D68); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 60, common 0x0068 through the generic roll) and is collected; its red soul 47 shares the ported throw routine 0x08025785 (SKILL_THROW_ROUTINE) with the Rock Armor soul. Animations: EnemyBomberArmorUpdate (0x080B3040) is ported from its traced routines: it shares the Rock Armor's probe-walk patrol (sub_080B2978, probes 0x0852872C) and death (sub_080B2CD8); its own throw (sub_080B2A80) plays animation 1, throws the bomb (sub_080B243C, a linked child copying facing, position, hit points and contact power) at frame 7 with sound 0x88, backs off one step when the player stays ahead within 99 pixels and resets to the walk; the bomb flies with animation 3, contact elements 2, its own boxes, 58 pixels up at vy -2.5 under gravity 0.125 through the probe walker (0x08528738, mode 2) at -2.0 - distance / 64 negated by the facing, sheds a fuse spark (sub_080B2FC4, animation 4) every fourth frame, halves and reverses on walls, counts the 16-frame fuse on the floor and bursts with the sub_08045A98 list 0 before sound 0x76 deletes it; unit-tested in bomber_armor_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x88 at the throw, 0x76 at the bomb's burst and the shared 0x6F / 0x72 of the death are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the + 0x72 bit 1 of the bomb, the + 0x46 hurtbox nudge and + 0x59 translucent bit of the create, the sub_0806B04C / sub_0806B1FC box refresh and the global pause 0x4BE are not ported; the burst list 0 effects come from the shared burst source.

Soul: drops, is collected and breathes fire (SkillBonePillarUse: Soma stands still and breathes fires of power 20, elements 2, sound 0x91). Animations: EnemyBonePillarUpdate is rewritten from its traced routines (shared with the Fish Head): an unseen controller (sub_080B3BAC / sub_080B3DCC) and up to eight stacked skulls, each its own enemy, facing alternately, falling onto the next when one dies (sub_080B3A68), the topmost in the homing list; each attacks a target in its 160 x 120 box (sub_080B36A0): the even ones breathe fire (sub_080B33C8) with smoke (sub_080B32F4), the odd ones spit a fireball (sub_080B350C), then they turn toward the target; struck down they shatter into three pieces (sub_080B3954, sub_080B3EE8); unit-tested and checked in a local capture of area 1 room 3, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds 0x6E (the breath), 0x7A (the fireball) and 0x6B (a skull shattering); all requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and starts SkillBuerUse with an R press (toggled, 5 MP per second, sounds 0x1A5 and 0x92): two exported flames orbit Soma at a radius growing to 28 around a point 20 pixels above his feet (8 while crouching), turning by 0x200 a frame against his facing, each a -10, -10, 20 x 20 type-6 attack of power 12 + 12 / 8 * INT / 2 with elements 2; a second press shrinks the radius by 2 a frame, then ends it. Unit-tested and checked in local captures, not emulator-compared; the flames' timed type-6 sparkle trail and sub_08042A54(2, 0x18) are not ported. Sounds: its native PlaySong sites are all requested and unit-tested: 0x84 every ninth attack frame above 0x32 (sub_080CBC64) and the three 0x6E of its staged death (sub_080CBEA4); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to). Animations: EnemyBuerUpdate is rewritten from its traced routines: the rolling spin on the 0x08528B64 walker (sub_080CC20C: slope impulses, friction to 0x4000, half-speed bounces, the affine angle by spin / 64, the fire facing the spin), state 1 rolling until it drops out of the room's lower edge (sub_080CC458), the state-2 idle, wait and attack (sub_080CBAEC, sub_080CBC64: spin-up toward its target with paired graphics-only fire bursts and 0x84), the hit callback starting the attack (sub_080CC514), the room exit (sub_080CC55C), the inert state 4 (sub_080CC48C), its fire sprite (sub_080CC3C8) and the staged death (sub_080CBEA4: the fire's wobble, flames, eight terminal flames at the exported 0x081194DC offsets); unit-tested and checked in a local capture of area 0 room 12, not emulator-compared. The +0x0F blink flag of the dying fire and body and the palette bits are not ported.

Soul: drops, is collected and starts SkillCagnazzoUse with an R press (toggled, 5 MP per second, sound 0x1AA): its exported guardian rides 16 pixels ahead of Soma and 32 above his feet with looping sequence 0 and a 10, 5, 20 x 20 type-6 attack of power 12 + 12 / 8 * INT / 2; a second press ends it. Unit-tested and checked in local captures (it killed a Skeleton in area 0 room 6), not emulator-compared; sub_08042A54(2, 0x14) is not run. Sounds: the shared controller requests 0x87 at the dive, Cagnazzo's additional 0x1BA and 0x1BC at death; unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and starts SkillCatoblepasUse with R held while Soma stands still on the ground (15 MP per second): Soma takes pose 0x35 (state 10) and every fifth frame breathes an exported gas cloud (0x8E with every other) that drifts forward for 26 frames as a -10, -10, 20 x 20 type-6 attack of power 10 + 10 / 8 * INT / 2 with elements 0x100. Unit-tested and checked in local captures (clouds killed Skeletons in area 0 room 6), not emulator-compared; the 0x131B8 & 0x800 bit and sub_08042A54(2, 0x1E) are not modelled. Sounds: EnemyCatoblepasUpdate calls EnemyGorgonUpdate, so it shares Gorgon's 0x67 breath cues (sub_08089560) and 0x71 death (sub_080896D8); both are requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 6, common item 0x0013 through the generic roll) and is collected, but its red soul 55 (catalog skill 05, routine missing) has no ported update yet. Animations: ported from EnemyChronomageCreate (0x080B712C) / EnemyChronomageUpdate (0x080B71F8) and the sub_080B6D68 idle, sub_080B6DEC time-stop, sub_080B6FB8 chase, sub_080B70B4 inert and sub_080B72B8 hurt handlers plus the sub_080B6C3C wisp child sharing the resources — animation 0 idle, 1 cast/death, 2 inert, 3 time-stop, 4/5 chase by target side, 6 wisp. Unit-tested in chronomage_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0xEC at the time-stop countdown is requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the gEwramData + 0x12FE4 time-scale writes, the + 0x4BE pause reads, the sub_080212F4(6) room-warp gate, the sub_08011F44 / sub_08011AD0 and sub_0803D18C palette fades, the sub_0800C5A8 call and the + 0x10 & 0x360 action mask are not ported (the attack flags approximate the mask and the damaged flag stands in for + 0x4BE); the + 0x54 field, the + 0x58 palette nibbles, the sub_0803E6BC palette restore, the sub_080428F0 / sub_08042884 box presets (exported frame boxes stand in), the sub_0803E654 sign draw (RNG bit 15), the wisp affine scale (affine_sx/sy approximation of the sub_0803E058 slot) and the sub_080421AC room query are not ported; no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 15, rare item 0x0001 through the generic roll) and is collected, but its red soul 22 (routine missing in the catalog) has no ported update yet. Animations: ported from sub_080BBFF0 / EnemyCockatriceUpdate (0x080BC164) and the sub_080BBCC4 patrol, sub_080BBD90 attack and sub_080BBEE4 death handlers — animation 0 looping probe walk (0x085288C0, mode 0x14, the (frame + 1) % 8 speed curve, the three-loop turnaround), state 1 attack with the sub_080BBAC4 rock at animation frame 0xA and the 0x20 return timer, state 2 death; the sub_080BB924 shadow child rides the parent's attachment with the affine bob/spin. Unit-tested in cockatrice_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x65 at the rock's end and at the death start and PlaySong 0x6E every eighth death tick are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the shadow's palette nibble, trail callback and scale are not ported and its affine bob/spin are approximated by aos_sine; the rock's launch velocity and + 0x58 palette byte are approximated (the still frame's attack record is empty, so a small own box stands in for the sub_080BC0F4 / sub_08021654 contact), its sub_0803E654 sign draw is the RNG bit 15, the gEwramData + 0x13270 bit-2 attack gate and the sub_080421AC room query are not modelled, the + 0x5A palette merges and the global pause 0x4BE are not ported, and there is no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops, is collected and, with R held (30 MP per second), runs Skill_Devil_Manticore_Curly_Use with variant 2: Soma enters state 9 (sub_0801A94C, newly ported: pose 0x20 for 45 frames with sound 0x1AB, transformation 0x4C, then 0x4B charging forward up to 6.0, invulnerable; 0x4D and braking on the way back), and once transformed the exported shell (sub_0802EE40, sound 0x93 every 8 frames) follows him while the soul attacks around him (type 6, box -24, -64, 48 x 68, power 0x32, elements 1, sound 0x1B0). A ceiling over the tall body ends it. Unit-tested and checked in local captures (it killed five Skeletons in area 0 room 6), not emulator-compared; the palette banks (0x080E126C, the white transformation frame), the sparkles and the sub_0803D18C blend are not modelled. Sounds: its native sounds, run through Curly's routines, are requested and unit-tested: 0x85 at the start of walk frame 4 (sub_08093218) and of attack frames 4, 7, 10 and 13 (sub_08093460), 0x1C3 at its death (sub_080935E8); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 29), adds 16 to CON every frame; a local run lowered a Skeleton's 13-damage hit on Soma to 5. Its entity runs after Soma's update, whose sub_08021FA4 resets the current stats to the equipped ones every frame; unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds 0x85 at + 0x0D 0x0B of the thrust and of the slash (sub_0808F6E8), 0x69 for a guarded blow and 0x72 at death (sub_0808F848); all are requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 5), sets 0x13260 bit 0x800000, with which Up and a new attack press cast the red soul during an attack (state 1, _0801C494); unit-tested in tests/test_aos_soma.c, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds 0x7D every 25 frames of the walk on screen and 0x127 as it brakes (sub_080B72F8), and 0x6E every eighth frame of its death (sub_080B747C); all requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops (soul_index 30, catalog red soul 30) but its update routine is not ported yet, so the soul is partial. Animations: ported from EnemyDiscArmorCreate (0x080B2228) / EnemyDiscArmorUpdate (0x080B22D4) and the sub_080B1F14 walk, sub_080B205C attack, sub_080B2148 death, sub_080B2370 hurt and sub_080B23C4 orbit handlers, plus the sub_080B1678 disc's eight-state machine, the sub_080B1428 shard, sub_080B14B4 glow child and sub_080B15EC angle helpers; unit-tested in disc_armor_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x74 (disc launch), 0x104 (shard throw), 0x73 (shard burst), 0x103 (disc recall), 0x6F and 0x6E (armor death) are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Loot: the native record drops common item 0x0067 (rare item 0).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 50, rare item 0x0017 through the generic roll) and is collected, but its red soul 33 (routine 0x080282DD) has no ported update yet. Sounds: PlaySong 0x89 during the last three ticks of the seed attack and PlaySong 0x6E every eighth tick of the death are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Animations: ported from EnemyDryadCreate (0x080AEAAC) / EnemyDryadUpdate (0x080AEB8C) and the sub_080AE4BC notice, sub_080AE554 attack, sub_080AE650 death and sub_080AE3FC hurt handlers — animation 0 idle, 1-2 the approach and loop, 3 the seed spray, 4-5 the death flinch, 6 the death; the seed sub_080AE7E4 walks table 0x08528604 and shares the landed tail sub_080AE8E8. Divergences: the seed spawn velocity is approximated as a distance-scaled lob (the native sub_0806CD38 corrections are not traced), the landing is the floor probe standing in for the sub_080AE78C room-entity callback, the seed contact record is positional with a 16 px reach standing in for the native hitbox extent, the + 0xF fade ledger, the + 0x58 facing nibble draw, the sub_0806D518 blink palette merge and the sub_080428F0 box preset are not ported, and there is no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillDurgaUse). Sounds: its native sounds, run through Curly's routines, are requested and unit-tested: 0x85 at the start of walk frame 4 (sub_08093218) and of attack frames 4, 7, 10 and 13 (sub_08093460), 0x1C3 at its death (sub_080935E8); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 150, common 0x000A through the generic roll) and is collected; its yellow soul 20 (routine 0x080322A1, the shared SkillPoisonWorm_Ectoplasm_Gargoyle_Use resistance skill) is ported through the generic yellow-soul path. Animations: EnemyEctoplasmCreate (0x080995B8) / EnemyEctoplasmUpdate (0x080994E0) and the sub_08099690 / sub_08099A3C handlers are ported — animation 0 looping drift, animation 1 the death; unit-tested in ectoplasm_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x6D at the lethal blow is requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the gEwramData + 0xA094 camera offsets cancel into world pixels, the sub_08021924 target-table bookkeeping behind the sub_08068AD4 activity box is not ported, the sub_0806AEAC wisp child (0x49/0xCF, priority + 0x5C - 1) is the shared flame effect in a 16 x 3 pixel area, the + 0x20 direction flag alternates the -16 / -32 pixel target bias, the sub_0806D4C0 global pause 0x4BE is taken as 0, the 0xFFFFFF00 palette merge and the + 0x5A/+ 0x2C bits are not ported, and there is no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 16), sets 0x13260 bit 0x2000000, which scales enemy experience by 0x133 / 256. Its entity runs after Soma's update, whose sub_08021FA4 resets the current stats to the equipped ones every frame; unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Sounds: its native sounds, run through the Valkyrie's routines, are requested and unit-tested: 0x87 as its charge starts (sub_0806E8AC) and 0x1CD at its death (sub_0806EBDC); a local run rendered both through the mixer (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 9, common 0x0022, rare 0x0019 through the generic roll) and is collected; its red soul 18 shares the ported SKILL_RIPPER_ROUTINE 0x08023A71 with the Ripper soul and casts as variant 0. Animations: EnemyEvilButcherCreate (0x080BFE1C) / EnemyEvilButcherUpdate (0x080BFF14) and the sub_080BFB58 / sub_080BFBF4 / sub_080BFCD8 handlers are ported — animation 0 looping patrol, animation 1 the throw; the cleaver (sub_080BF738), gore (sub_080BF990) and particle (sub_080BF6B8) children are ported as linked roles with still frames 8 and 9; unit-tested in butcher_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x89 at the cleaver throw, 0x1C1 at the death and 0x13A on the cleaver and gore floor stick are requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Divergences: the + 0x58 fade bits, the + 0x59 flags, the + 0xF death flag, the sub_0806D4C0 pause, the sub_080421AC box query, the + 0x5A palette bits of sub_080BFECC and the sub_0803E654 sign draw (approximated by the RNG sign) are not ported; the sub_080020A0 surface probes are normalized into room pixels; there is no emulator comparison.

Soul: drops (soul_index 29, soul_rarity 12, common/rare rates 20/30) and is collected; its red soul 29 is ported (aos_soul_red_fish_head). Animations: EnemyFishHeadCreate (0x080B3F34) / EnemyFishHeadUpdate (0x080B3F40) are thunks to sub_080B3BAC(e, 1) / sub_080B3DCC — the Bone Pillar's shared controller and skull routines with the variant-1 resource row of 0x081193DC (frames 0x08243830); unit-tested in bone_pillar_tests. Sounds: the shared routines' PlaySong 0x6B (skull shatter), 0x6E (breath) and 0x7A (fireball) apply, unit-tested through the Bone Pillar tests. Divergences: identical to Bone Pillar's (no emulator comparison).

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillFleamanUse: a hopping flea; its end sparks are not created). Sounds: its only native sound, 0x72 at the start of its death (sub_080C2388), is requested, unit-tested and mixed (a local run rendered it, not listened to).

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 21), ORs resistance 0x100 into Soma's resistances every frame: sub_08021654 now quarters instead of halving the damage of element 0x100 (the Gorgon's breath, a gold Medusa Head) and refuses their petrification (resistance bits 6-8). Unit-tested, not emulator-compared; its status cure (sub_08021E50 with a status set) is not modelled.

Soul: drops, is collected and casts SkillGhostUse; its visual trail helper is not ported. Animations: the appearance gate, attacking flight, random target height, damping, acceleration, close-target impulse, event state, death and capped hidden room producer are ported and unit-tested. Sounds: 0x6E on a lethal hit and 0xD6 at soul cast are connected; not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 34), adds 4 to LCK every frame (the drop rolls' luck term). Its entity runs after Soma's update, whose sub_08021FA4 resets the current stats to the equipped ones every frame; unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds one PlaySong, 0x6D in the death callback sub_080C32EC; it is requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and summons its ghost (Skill_Witch_GiantGhost_Use, argument 1: a translucent ghost grown over Soma whose touches throw spirits of power 30, elements 0x20). Animations: EnemyGiantGhostUpdate is rewritten from its traced routines: the drift 48 pixels over its target and the flight after touching Soma (sub_0807D33C, the contact sub_0807E328 flagging + 0x21), the charge (sub_0807D65C), the death blinking out with ghost wisps (sub_0807D88C, sub_0807E228 / sub_08069134), the pulsing translucent aura with its afterimages and the two eyes looking at the target (sub_0807D9B8, sub_0807E074, sub_0807DBB4, sub_0807DE14) and the inert state 3; unit-tested and checked in a local capture of area 1 room 8, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds 0x87 (the charge) and 0x6B (the lethal blow); both requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and its yellow soul 10 runs the shared flag routine 0x08032205 (argument 0x00200000 ORed into the status flags every frame); unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Animations: the segmented worm is ported from its traced routines — the shared create sub_080AD7F0 (random facing, floor snap, four linked segments spaced 0xA0000 with + 0x1E index and + 0x22 index << 12, graphics 0x081E4184, palette 0x0820B724 bank 0, frames 0x08237C44, animation 3), the parent seven-state machine sub_080AE0E0 (the sub_0806CFFC decision box, the sub_080ADB94 hop and sub_080AD9FC settle, the state-3 death lunge, the state 4/5 delete timers and the state-6 affine idle), the segment five-state machine sub_080ADC2C and the segment-to-parent damage sub_080AD748; unit-tested in worm_tests. Sounds: PlaySong 0x70 at the parent's death is requested and unit-tested, not listened to. Loot: the native record's rare 0x000F drop rolls through the generic path. Divergences: the affine transform is approximated by the renderer's rotation on e->angle (the secondary sine scale is not modelled), the + 0x5A palette merge and the + 0x5C parameter are not ported, the segments are emitted on the first update (the Headhunter pattern) instead of inside the create, the dust of sub_0806D5C0 is approximated by AOS_EFFECT_DUST and the activity-window/sleep helpers of the generic controller are not applied.

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 28), adds 12 to CON (DEF + 6) every frame. Its entity runs after Soma's update, whose sub_08021FA4 resets the current stats to the equipped ones every frame; unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Sounds: a source audit of its block finds 0x67 at + 0x0D 0x1E and 0x32 of the breath step (sub_08089560) and 0x71 in the death callback sub_080896D8; both are requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and, equipped (yellow 35), adds 8 to LCK every frame (the drop rolls' luck term). Its entity runs after Soma's update, whose sub_08021FA4 resets the current stats to the equipped ones every frame; unit-tested, not emulator-compared. Sounds: EnemyGremlinUpdate calls EnemyGargoyleUpdate, so it shares Gargoyle's 0x87 dive (sub_08086534) and 0x6E death (sub_08086878); both are requested and unit-tested, not listened to or emulator-compared.

Soul: drops, is collected and casts (SkillHarpyUse). Sounds: 0x8B at the shared idle-flight animation boundary, 0x87 as it dives, 0x89 after each feather volley and 0x1C3 at death are requested and unit-tested; the 0x8B timing is source-adapted because sub_080756FC's rising flight remains simplified.

Soul: drops, is collected and starts SkillImpUse with an R press (toggled, 3 MP per second, sound 0x19E): the exported familiar follows Soma 40 pixels above his feet by 1/32 of the distance, hovers in a sine figure and, by chance, dives at the nearest enemy of the homing list by 1/16 of the distance, attacking with its frames' boxes (type 6, power 15 + 15 / 8 * INT / 2, elements 0x11); a second press makes it blink for 16 frames, then it leaves. Unit-tested and checked in local captures (it killed Skeletons in area 0 room 6), not emulator-compared; sub_08042A54(2, 0x3C) is not run. Sounds: its only native sound, 0x72 at the start of its death (sub_080C4ED4), is requested and unit-tested; a local run rendered it (not listened to).

Soul: drops (soul_rarity 2, common item 0x007B and rare item 0x007C through the generic roll), is collected and enables ability soul 4 (index 3): the dive kick of sub_08017D90 through the AOS_MOVE_DIVE_KICK bit, unit-tested with the movement suite, not emulator-compared.
